_readme: Maps a project/issuer label to its pinned Ed25519 public key. Accepted key encodings: raw 64-char hex, base64 SPKI DER (openssl pkey -pubout -outform DER | base64, i.e. 'MCowBQYDK2VwAyEA...'), an 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA...' line, or a PEM block. Bundles signed by keys not listed here render with an 'untrusted issuer' warning and cannot be downloaded. (Keys with unparseable values are silently skipped.)
